title: Charley Ellis - The Evolution of the Asset Management Industry

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Over the past several decades.
reader_summary.overview: Over the past several decades. When I think about my pantheon of all-time great investment thinkers and writers, our guest today stands out as one of the industry's legends. Charley Ellis has played the most significant role in how I think about the investment industry.

key_points.text: Charley Ellis has played the most significant role in how I think about the investment industry.
Ellis is the founder and former managing partner of Greenwich Associates, an international consultancy where he advised large institutional investors, foundations.
